short: The library, the Storybook stories, the old gallery, the checks
is: The package's code in five parts: `lib/` is the public entry, `stories/` holds the component gallery's Storybook stories, docs pages and frame, `routes/` hosts the old Kit gallery and `gallery/` is its frame (both built until Storybook replaces them; the token pages' parts in `gallery/` stay), and `checks/` are specs that guard the package's own shape.
conventions: Specs sit beside the code they test (`*.spec.ts` in node, `*.svelte.spec.ts` in real Chromium); `expect.requireAssertions` is on.

A gallery page registers itself with a `meta.ts` under `routes/components/<slug>/` exporting `meta` (a title and one of the groups in `gallery/groups.ts`); the registry finds it by glob and turns away, rather than throws on, a malformed, duplicate or misplaced one.
The gallery's user-visible words live in `gallery/groups.ts` and the frame; the frame is imported through the `$gallery` alias.

Reserved inside `lib/`: `motion/` (the one place motion libraries may be imported), `lazy/` (the one place heavy libraries load, by dynamic import only) and `styles/tokens.css` (the style scan's one exempt file). `motion/` and `styles/` exist today; `lazy/` does not.

`lib/index.ts` is the whole public surface of the code: the paper lists (`PAPER_MOVES`, `PAPER_CLASSES`), the environment names and `parseSkin`, and the token model. The styles are a separate side-effect entry, `@zurfur/ui/styles` (`lib/styles/index.ts`), and the host may also import `@zurfur/ui/tokens.json` and `@zurfur/ui/tokens.additions.json`.

Only `gallery/skin-store.ts` touches storage, and `localStorage` alone; every other file refuses all storage and `cookie`, and no file reaches the private file store (`navigator.storage`, `getDirectory`). `app.html` holds the gallery's one boot script, pinned by the hash in `gallery/boot-script.ts` and kept out of prettier.
Stories import `@zurfur/ui` by its public entry only, never a path into `lib/` (see `stories/`); `.mdx` files are allowed only under `stories/`.

fs.name: app.html
fs.role: the page shell, holding the gallery's one boot script (pinned by hash in gallery/boot-script.ts; kept out of prettier)

fs.name: checks/
fs.role: specs over the package itself: the lint boundary rules and the import tiers, declared imports, forbidden files (only plain files and real folders, read without following links; a backslash in any name refused; server-side, hooks, service-worker and node_modules names tested in every folder of the path, JSX, and any extension off the list .ts, .svelte, .css, except NODE.inf.json in any folder, app.html at the root and the two token JSON files by exact path), the style and network scans (scan/), serve config (loopback serving, and Kit's inline options read so no file renaming, service worker or svelte config file gets in), tsconfig parity with web, workspace shape and the public entry; the tokens (tokens/: the copy step, the generator, the writer behind `yarn tokens` and their specs), the contrast, fonts, paper and boot-script specs, and the media spec (its own Vitest project, client-media, run after every other, using the narrow emulateMedia command in media-command.ts); the Storybook checks (storybook-config: the config folder's four files and main.ts's keys; storybook-channel: the server-channel hook; story-imports, story-fixtures, story-coverage and docs-pages over src/stories/); built-output.ts, run by the gate and CI after every Kit build and, with --storybook, after every Storybook build: it refuses remote URLs a page loads by itself in the built CSS and HTML, any http-equiv but Kit's content-security-policy, and ZURFUR_ or DATABASE_URL in any text file (exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 unreadable)

fs.name: gallery/
fs.role: the gallery frame: the registry (page discovery), page meta, the nav groups, GalleryNav, GalleryPage and GalleryState; skin-store.ts (the one file that touches storage), boot-script.ts (the pinned hash of the page shell's boot script), SkinSwitch (the header's Skin switch), GallerySkins (a state in Paper dark and Paper light, handing each copy its skin), contrast/ (the contrast arithmetic and the declared pairs), usage-text.ts and UsageText (usage lines as text and code, never HTML), token-source.ts (the token model for the pages) and the token pages' parts (TokenModelGate, TokenSection, TokenList, ContrastTable, EasingCurve with easing-curve.ts, FontFaces, MoveSheet)

fs.name: lib/
fs.role: the public entry (index.ts) and motion/: paper-moves.css (the paper moves' keyframes and classes, the motion adapter's CSS half) and paper-moves.ts (PAPER_MOVES); only a later adapter applies the move classes

fs.name: lib/styles/
fs.role: design tokens, the two skins and the paper look; the styles entry

fs.name: routes/
fs.role: the old Kit gallery host, built until Storybook replaces it: the layout (header, nav, main), the index and components/<slug>/ pages, among them the six Tokens and paper pages (colour, type, space-and-shape, shadows, motion-and-sound, paper)

fs.name: stories/
fs.role: the component gallery in Storybook: stories, docs pages, fixtures and the frame
